title: 2001 Upper Deck NFL Legends #47 Randy Moss Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2001 Upper Deck NFL Legends sports trading card features Randy Moss, a legendary football player who played for the Minnesota Vikings. The card is part of the base set and has the card number 47. It is perfect for any collector who is a fan of the National Football League (NFL) and wants to add a piece of football history to their collection. 

The card is manufactured by Upper Deck and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. It is not autographed, but it still has a lot of value. This card is from the 2001 season and is a must-have for any fan of Randy Moss or the Minnesota Vikings. Get your hands on this iconic sports trading card today!
